title: Used to, was going to, should have
summary: Three more compound pasts on the pattern of B1 unit 1: **used to** with `-ArdY` (*Öň köp kitap okardym*), **was going to** with `-jAkdY` (*Saňa jaň etjekdim, ýöne…*) and **should have** with `-mAlYdY` (*Ir gelmelidiň*), and **could have** with `-(Y)p bilerdi` (*Sen maňa jaň edip bilerdiň!*).
canDo: Talk about past habits and how things have changed
Say what you were going to do, and why it didn't happen
Say what someone should or shouldn't have done
Say what could or couldn't have happened
